MONSTER Season 5 already has THREE different ideas being worked on, with Ian Brennan revealing that he and Ryan Murphy are currently deciding which story will become the next chapter of the Netflix anthology.

Brennan explained that they usually develop several subjects at once before choosing the one with enough depth to carry an entire season, meaning the next MONSTER story is already actively taking shape.

He also revealed that they have a 10 season plan for the franchise and confirmed that he is currently writing THE WATCHER Season 2.

Season 5 is already on the table with three possible stories, and MONSTER is being planned far beyond that.

Netflix is getting ready to bring a new rom-com to the screen. ‘Guarding Stars’, starring Jared Padalecki and Leighton Meester, is currently eyeing a November 18, 2026 release.

The upcoming film pairs the two actors for a romantic comedy that could make for a lighthearted addition to Netflix’s late-year lineup. While the November 18 date is currently being reported as the targeted release window, Netflix has yet to officially confirm the date.

With Padalecki and Meester leading the cast, ‘Guarding Stars’ is shaping up to be a new Netflix rom-com worth keeping an eye on.

Will ‘Guarding Stars’ be on your watchlist this November?

Cliff Booth is back, and his next adventure is getting its first big reveal. The first trailer for ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’ will debut in theaters this weekend ahead of ‘Resident Evil’ screenings.

Following its theatrical debut, the trailer will arrive globally on Netflix next week, giving audiences everywhere their first proper look at the highly anticipated follow-up.

The film continues the story of Cliff Booth, the fan-favorite character played by Brad Pitt in Quentin Tarantino’s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. With the title promising even more misadventures, the upcoming project is set to take the character into a new chapter.

The first look is almost here.

The ‘MONSTER’ anthology continues to divide critics, with all four installments currently sitting below the 60% threshold on Rotten Tomatoes. The scores in this comparison range from 57% for ‘DAHMER’ to just 22% for ‘THE ED GEIN STORY’, while the newest chapter, ‘THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY,’ stands at 42%.

The franchise launched with ‘DAHMER: THE JEFFREY DAHMER STORY’, starring Evan Peters, followed by ‘THE LYLE AND ERIK MENENDEZ STORY’ with Nicholas Alexander Chavez and Cooper Koch. Both seasons examined infamous real-life cases through dramatized portrayals of the people, families, and circumstances surrounding them.

The third installment, ‘THE ED GEIN STORY’, starring Charlie Hunnam, currently holds the lowest critics score at 22%. Meanwhile, Ella Beatty’s ‘THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY’ has climbed back up to 42%, putting it ahead of the Ed Gein season but still below the anthology’s first two installments.

It’s worth noting that the Tomatometer measures the percentage of positive reviews from critics, rather than averaging their individual scores or measuring how popular a series is with audiences.

With ‘THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY’ now streaming on Netflix, how would you rank the four seasons based on what you’ve watched?

Netflix star Phoebe Dynevor turned heads with her understated wedding-day beauty look as she married Cameron Fuller in Provence.

Best known to Netflix viewers for playing Daphne Bridgerton in Bridgerton and Emily in Fair Play, Dynevor opted for soft, romantic makeup that kept the focus on her natural features.

Her makeup artist Jennifer Luney Tioseco created a radiant complexion with warm blush, subtle champagne eyeshadow, brown eyeliner and mascara. Her lips were finished with a nude liner and soft nude-pink matte lipstick.

The beauty look complemented Dynevor’s custom Louis Vuitton wedding dress and lengthy silk veil, while her sleek low updo kept the overall bridal styling polished and elegant.

The first clip from Alejandro G. Iñárritu’s upcoming film ‘Digger’ has been released, offering a first glimpse at Tom Cruise in his latest major dramatic role.

Cruise stars as a powerful CEO in the highly anticipated film, marking his collaboration with acclaimed filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu, the director behind Birdman and The Revenant.

With the first footage now out, ‘Digger’ is beginning to reveal more about the world, characters, and tone of what could be one of Cruise’s most intriguing upcoming projects.

What do you think of Tom Cruise’s first look in ‘Digger’?

Millie Bobby Brown and Jake Bongiovi have welcomed their second child through adoption, expanding their family just over a year after becoming parents for the first time. 

The couple adopted their first daughter in the summer of 2025 and have kept her identity completely private, choosing not to share her name or face publicly. 

Reports of baby number two emerged after Brown shared footage from a family trip to the Dolomites, where she could be seen carrying one child while Bongiovi appeared with another baby in a carrier. 

Brown has previously spoken openly about always wanting a large family and said adoption had been part of that dream since she was young. 

At just 22, Millie Bobby Brown is reportedly now a mother of two, beginning another completely new chapter of life with Jake Bongiovi.

The Inbetweeners are officially back in production. Netflix has confirmed that filming has begun in the UK on the third movie, bringing Simon Bird, James Buckley, Joe Thomas and Blake Harrison back as Will, Jay, Simon and Neil.

Set photos have now surfaced showing the original four together again, with several scenes being filmed around a major wedding. Three of the lads have been spotted dressed in suits, while a mystery bride has also been seen on set. The identity of the groom has not been officially revealed.

Emily Head has also been spotted filming, reprising her role as Carli D'Amato, Simon's longtime crush from the original series. New cast members including Hannah Cruz have also been seen filming, although details about their characters are being kept under wraps.

The new movie reunites the original creative team, with creators Damon Beesley and Iain Morris returning to write and direct. Netflix has not yet announced an official release date, but production is now underway.

Vicky Krieps and Ella Beatty celebrated the release of MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY together as the new season officially began streaming on Netflix today. 

Beatty leads the fourth season as Lizzie Borden, while Krieps plays Bridget “Maggie” Sullivan, the Borden family maid whose relationship with Lizzie becomes one of the central parts of the story. 

The pair attended the New York premiere alongside Charlie Hunnam, Billie Lourd, Jessica Barden and other members of the cast before all eight episodes dropped on September 17. 

Their complicated relationship drives much of the new chapter, with the series exploring repression, desire and female rage while heavily dramatizing the infamous 1892 Borden murders. 

MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY is now streaming on Netflix, and Vicky Krieps and Ella Beatty are officially at the center of the anthology’s blood red era.

MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY has officially hit the No. 1 spot on Netflix just 12 hours after its release, giving the anthology an immediate monster sized debut.

Ella Beatty leads the fourth season as Lizzie Borden, marking the franchise’s first female centered story after seasons focused on Jeffrey Dahmer, the Menendez brothers and Ed Gein. 

Vicky Krieps stars as Bridget “Maggie” Sullivan alongside Charlie Hunnam, Rebecca Hall, Billie Lourd, Jessica Barden and Sarah Paulson in the eight episode season. 

The new chapter reimagines the infamous 1892 Borden murders through themes of repression, female rage and the mystery surrounding a woman who was tried and ultimately acquitted of killing her father and stepmother. 

MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY is now streaming on Netflix, and reaching No. 1 within its first 12 hours is a huge start for the anthology’s blood red era.

Acclaimed actress Yuri Nakamura has tragically passed away at age 44 following a courageous battle with rectal cancer. Best known internationally for her recent role as Irene in Netflix’s hit romantic comedy Romantics Anonymous, her agency Alpha Agency shared that she passed away peacefully on September 1 surrounded by loved ones.

BREAKING: Matthew Rhys has officially won the Emmy for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie for his performance in THE BEAST IN ME.

Rhys earned the award for his dark, unsettling performance in the limited series, adding another major win to a career that already includes an Emmy for THE AMERICANS.

But the night became even bigger when Rhys also won Outstanding Lead Actor in a Comedy Series for WIDOW’S BAY, making him the first performer ever to win lead acting Emmys across drama, comedy and limited series.

Two acting Emmys in one night, and one of them for THE BEAST IN ME. Matthew Rhys just turned the 2026 Emmys into a career defining night.

SHE THOUGHT SHE WAS STARTING A NEW CHAPTER… BUT GETTING CLOSE TO HER BOSS’S WIFE OPENS A DOOR SHE CAN’T CLOSE. 👀🔥

Louise is a single mother who begins an affair with her psychiatrist boss, David. At the same time, she secretly becomes friends with his mysterious wife, Adele. As Louise gets deeper into their complicated relationship, strange secrets and mind games begin to surface.

Behind Her Eyes is a psychological mystery thriller filled with obsession, secrets, manipulation, and unexpected twists. The story keeps you guessing, and the final revelation is the kind that makes you rethink everything you watched. 👀🔥 Netflix officially classifies it across TV Mysteries and TV Thrillers, with “Psychological” and “Mind Game” descriptors.

MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY is now officially streaming on Netflix, bringing Ryan Murphy and Ian Brennan’s true crime anthology back for its fourth chapter. 

Ella Beatty stars as Lizzie Borden, the Massachusetts woman accused of murdering her father and stepmother in 1892 before later being acquitted at trial. 

Vicky Krieps stars as Bridget “Maggie” Sullivan alongside Charlie Hunnam as Andrew Borden, while Sarah Paulson appears as Aileen Wuornos as the story stretches across generations. 

The eight episode season makes Lizzie the first female subject of MONSTER, exploring repression, rage and the relationships surrounding one of America’s most infamous true crime mysteries. 

All eight episodes of MONSTER: THE LIZZIE BORDEN STORY are now streaming on Netflix, and the anthology’s blood red era has officially begun.
